units.title: SATELLITE SYSTEM AUTOMATION AND REMOTE MANAGEMENT

learning_outcomes.description: Introduction to Satellite Automation Systems

performance_criteria.description: Define satellite automation
Discuss Satellite automation roles in modern communication systems
Explain the components required for automating satellite systems, such as programmable controllers and motorized mounts.
Compare manual vs. automated satellite system setups, highlighting the benefits of automation in large-scale operations.
Discuss case studies where satellite automation has improved signal reception and system maintenance.

learning_outcomes.description: Implementing Remote Monitoring Systems

performance_criteria.description: Explain how to set up remote monitoring for satellite systems using tools like SNMP (Simple Network Management Protocol) and web-based platforms.
Describe how to configure alerts for signal degradation, weather-related issues, or hardware malfunctions.
Demonstrate how to perform system health checks remotely and monitor performance metrics like signal-to-noise ratio and uplink power.
Explain how remote troubleshooting and diagnostics reduce on-site visits and enhance system reliability.

learning_outcomes.description: Programming Satellite Tracking Systems

performance_criteria.description: Discuss how to configure tracking systems to automatically adjust dish positioning based on satellite movements
Program satellite motor controllers (DiSEqC) for multi-satellite reception using advanced scheduling techniques.
Demonstrate how to maintain accurate tracking during low-earth orbit (LEO) satellite passes.
Troubleshoot common tracking errors caused by system delays or mechanical faults

learning_outcomes.description: Automation Software Integration

performance_criteria.description: Introduce software platforms used for satellite automation (e.g., Nova for Windows, SatPC32).
Demonstrate how to configure satellite communication automation software for different types of satellites.
Show how to create automated satellite connection schedules to handle multiple users and bandwidth allocation.
Discuss security protocols needed when integrating automation software into satellite systems.

learning_outcomes.description: Advanced Automation in Commercial and Military Applications

performance_criteria.description: Compare commercial and military satellite automation systems, noting key differences in security and reliability requirements.
Demonstrate how failover systems work in military satellite automation for continuous communication.
Discuss the importance of encryption and signal security in remote satellite management for military applications.
Provide examples of automated satellite systems used for real-time data transmission in remote monitoring applications (e.g., weather, disaster management).

learning_outcomes.description: High-Frequency Satellite Communication (Ka-band and Above)

performance_criteria.description: Describe the characteristics of Ka-band and Q/V-band frequencies and their uses in modern satellite communication systems.
Explain how atmospheric conditions, such as rain and humidity, affect high-frequency signal transmission and strategies to mitigate these effects.
Compare the bandwidth capacity and data rates of C-band, Ku-band, and Ka-band systems.
Demonstrate how to configure and align dishes for high-frequency satellites using advanced equipment.

learning_outcomes.description: Satellite Communication for IoT (Internet of Things)

performance_criteria.description: Define the role of satellite systems in IoT networks, especially in remote and rural applications.
Demonstrate how to integrate IoT devices (e.g., sensors, actuators) with satellite networks for real-time monitoring.
Discuss the benefits and challenges of using low-power wide-area networks (LPWAN) in satellite IoT applications.
Show how to maintain communication reliability for IoT systems in varying weather conditions and remote environments.

learning_outcomes.description: Satellite Data Compression and Bandwidth Optimization

performance_criteria.description: Explain different data compression techniques used in satellite communication (e.g., Huffman coding, LZW compression).
Discuss bandwidth optimization strategies for high-traffic satellite systems, such as adaptive modulation and bandwidth throttling.
Compare the efficiency of various data transmission protocols (e.g., TCP/IP vs. UDP) in satellite communication.
Demonstrate how to apply bandwidth management techniques in commercial satellite networks to improve data throughput.

learning_outcomes.description: Quantum Satellite Communication

performance_criteria.description: Introduce the concept of quantum communication and its potential in satellite communication.
Explain how quantum key distribution (QKD) ensures secure communication between ground stations and satellites.
Demonstrate the principles of entanglement and quantum cryptography used in satellite systems.
Discuss future applications of quantum satellites in areas like secure government communication and global financial systems.

learning_outcomes.description: Advanced Satellite Link Budget Analysis

performance_criteria.description: Explain how to calculate the link budget for advanced satellite communication systems, including factors such as free space loss, antenna gain, and system no
Analyse the impact of environmental factors on link budget performance and strategies to optimize communication links.
Demonstrate how to perform link budget calculations for high-capacity communication satellites.
Present case studies of link budget optimization in commercial satellite communication systems.

learning_outcomes.description: Designing Custom Satellite Systems for Enterprises

performance_criteria.description: Discuss the requirements and specifications for designing custom satellite communication systems for large enterprises.
Demonstrate how to conduct a site survey to assess the environmental and structural challenges of satellite installation.
Show how to select the appropriate modulation schemes and bandwidth to meet enterprise-level data requirements.
Present a project where learners design a satellite system for a telecommunication or broadcasting company, ensuring scalability and future expansion.

learning_outcomes.description: Integrating Satellite Systems with Ground Networks

performance_criteria.description: Explain the integration of satellite networks with terrestrial communication systems, including fiber-optic and microwave links.
Discuss challenges of satellite-terrestrial integration, such as latency and signal handoff between networks.
Demonstrate how to create a hybrid communication system combining satellite and terrestrial infrastructure for redundancy.
Perform simulations of satellite-ground network integration, focusing on load balancing and signal routing.

learning_outcomes.description: Disaster Recovery and Redundancy Planning

performance_criteria.description: Discuss the role of satellite communication in disaster recovery planning for critical industries’ infrastructures (e.g., healthcare, banking).
Design a redundant satellite network for a business, ensuring communication reliability in the event of natural disasters or equipment failure.
Compare satellite-based disaster recovery solutions with traditional communication recovery methods.
Demonstrate how to implement failover protocols to switch to satellite communication when terrestrial systems are down.

learning_outcomes.description: Designing Satellite Systems for Rural and Remote Areas

performance_criteria.description: Explain the specific challenges of designing satellite systems for remote areas with limited infrastructure.
Demonstrate how to create low-cost satellite installations for rural schools, healthcare facilities, or government offices.
Discuss sustainable energy options (e.g., solar power) for powering satellite communication systems in off-grid locations.
Perform a site survey and create a system plan for a rural satellite installation, including power, bandwidth, and maintenance considerations.

learning_outcomes.description: Space Debris and Satellite System Longevity

performance_criteria.description: Explain the increasing issue of space debris and its impact on satellite system design and deployment.
Discuss the best practices for extending the operational life of satellites and avoiding collisions with space debris.
Demonstrate how to incorporate propulsion systems into satellites for orbital adjustments to avoid debris.
Present a report on sustainable satellite design, focusing on materials and systems that reduce the risk of generating space debris.

units.title: SATELLITE COMMUNICATION SECURITY AND RISK MANAGEMENT

learning_outcomes.description: Satellite Encryption and Data Security

performance_criteria.description: Explain encryption techniques used in satellite communication, such as AES (Advanced Encryption Standard) and RSA for secure data transmission.
Demonstrate how to implement end-to-end encryption for satellite communication systems, ensuring data confidentiality and integrity.
Discuss the impact of quantum computing on current encryption methods and how satellite systems must adapt for post-quantum encryption.
Perform encryption setup and verification tasks on commercial satellite receivers and ground stations, ensuring compliance with international security standards.

learning_outcomes.description: Satellite Network Vulnerabilities and Threat Mitigation

performance_criteria.description: Identify common vulnerabilities in satellite communication systems, including man-in-the-middle attacks, jamming, and signal spoofing.
Demonstrate techniques to secure satellite communication links, such as frequency hopping and spread spectrum technology, to reduce vulnerability to jamming.
Discuss the importance of access control and authentication mechanisms in protecting satellite communication networks from unauthorized access.
Perform a vulnerability assessment and risk analysis of a satellite communication system, identifying potential weak points and proposing mitigation strategies.

learning_outcomes.description: Cybersecurity for Ground Stations and Satellite Operations Centers

performance_criteria.description: Discuss the importance of securing ground stations and Network Operations Centers (NOCs) against cyber threats such as malware, DDoS attacks, and insider threats.
Demonstrate how to implement firewalls, intrusion detection systems (IDS), and intrusion prevention systems (IPS) for satellite ground stations.
Explain the importance of multi-factor authentication (MFA) and role-based access control (RBAC) in protecting sensitive satellite control systems.
Perform a cybersecurity audit of a simulated ground station setup, identifying and addressing potential security gaps.

learning_outcomes.description: Satellite System Failures and Disaster Recovery Plans

performance_criteria.description: Discuss the most common causes of satellite system failures, such as signal degradation, equipment malfunctions, or power outages.
Design a comprehensive disaster recovery plan for satellite communication systems, ensuring rapid recovery in case of natural disasters or cyberattacks.
Demonstrate the use of redundancy techniques such as backup satellites, dual-ground stations, and failover systems to ensure continuous communication.
Conduct a disaster recovery simulation, ensuring learners can quickly restore satellite communication after a system failure or breach.

learning_outcomes.description: International Satellite Security Regulations and Compliance

performance_criteria.description: Explain key international satellite security regulations, such as ITU (International Telecommunication Union) guidelines and military-grade security protocols.
Discuss the compliance requirements for satellite systems operating in sensitive industries, such as military, aerospace, and government communication.
Demonstrate how to implement security standards that comply with GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) and other global privacy laws in satellite data transmission.
Perform an audit of a satellite system's compliance with international security regulations, identifying areas that require improvement to meet industry standards.
